steps.title: Select robot parameters
steps.instruction: Choose right‑mount and left‑mount pipette types that cover the volume range required, decide for each whether to use filtered or regular tips (the protocol will load the appropriate tip size, e.g., 20 µL tips for a 20 µL pipette or 1000 µL filtered/non‑filtered tips for a 1000 µL pipette), specify Reagent labware 1 (slot 1) and optional Reagent labware 2 (slot 2), and select a 12‑well reservoir (mastermix will be created in well A1 of the trough in slot 3, other wells may be used as needed).

substeps.instruction: Choose tip filter option for each pipette.
Assign optional reagent labware 2 to slot 2.
Choose 12‑well reservoir for mastermix destination (well A1).

steps.title: Upload master mix CSV
steps.instruction: Prepare a CSV file that includes a header line describing each reagent and its location, then upload the file using the ‘Upload master mix CSV’ field.

steps.title: Generate and download protocol
steps.instruction: Click ‘Download your protocol’ to generate the Opentrons protocol file and save it to your computer.

steps.title: Load protocol into OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded protocol file via ‘Upload protocol into OT App’.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map: place the selected 12‑well reservoir in slot 3 (well A1 will receive the master mix), place reagent labware 1 in slot 1, place reagent labware 2 (if used) in slot 2, and load the appropriate tip racks for the chosen pipettes.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate each piece of labware, each tip rack, and both pipettes (right and left mounts) following the app’s calibration routine.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App; the robot will execute the protocol, transferring each reagent from its source location to well A1 of the trough in slot 3 to assemble the master mix.

steps.title: Robot transfers reagents
steps.instruction: The robot aspirates each reagent from the specified source labware and dispenses it into well A1 of the trough (slot 3), creating the master mix as defined in the CSV.
